report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations mostly 78-94ms; one 344ms outlier. Traces show successful redis reserve_inventory, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order spans with pool size 1 and idle 1. No errors, timeouts, or saturation appear. Current evidence does not establish any taxonomy cause; metrics and topology were excluded, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Gateway and downstream service metrics (latency percentiles, error rates) for the incident window
Service topology to attribute the 344ms outlier to a specific hop
Redis and postgres server-side latency/error telemetry to rule out redis-timeout or db-pool-exhaustion
Payment service latency telemetry to assess downstream-latency
Baseline latency distribution to judge whether 78-94ms is anomalous
